## Notes

Released 2008-08-26; Dave Kaemmer and John W. Henry; built from NASCAR Racing 2003 Season code with new tire model; LIDAR-scanned cars and tracks; subscription; Rookie to A licenses; no-blame Safety Rating; Elo-style iRating; 13-week seasons with weekly track rotation; eNASCAR iRacing Series.
